description: This file implements background I/O operations for Redis, including thread management, job queue handling, and specific background tasks like file closing and fsync. It manages background jobs via multiple threads, with synchronization primitives, and provides APIs for job creation, status checking, and thread termination.

methods.name: bioInit
methods.description: Initializes the background I/O system, spawns worker threads.

methods.name: bioCreateBackgroundJob
methods.description: Creates and enqueues a new background job of a specified type.

methods.name: bioProcessBackgroundJobs
methods.description: Thread function that processes background jobs from the queue.

methods.name: bioPendingJobsOfType
methods.description: Returns the number of pending jobs of a specific type.

methods.name: bioWaitStepOfType
methods.description: Blocks until the next job of a specific type is processed, returning remaining jobs.

methods.name: bioKillThreads
methods.description: Uncleanly terminates all background worker threads.
